headline: A Season That Changed Everything
subheadline: How a rebuilding year became a record-setting one
body: The season opened with more questions than answers. Twelve returning players, a new coaching staff, and a schedule nobody would have called forgiving. What followed surprised everyone, including the team itself.
author: Dana Whitmore
caption: The team celebrates after the regional final.
pull_quote: Nobody expected us to be here. That was the point.

headline: Building the Garden on Third Street
subheadline: Two summers, four hundred volunteers, one lot
body: What started as a cleanup day became a two-year project. Neighbors cleared the lot in June, planted the first beds in September, and have not stopped since.
author: Marcus Feld
caption: Volunteers plant the first raised beds.
pull_quote: We stopped waiting for someone else to do it.
